description: 7 reflection prompts shown after the Shadow Work meditation. Same for every session (per client confirmation). Answers stored in sh_shadow_work_responses.prompt_1..prompt_7.
prompts: What came up for me during this meditation?
What emotion did I feel most strongly?
Where do I feel this emotion in my body?
When was the first time I remember feeling this way?
What belief might be connected to this feeling?
What part of me still feels unseen, unsafe, or unheard?
What do I need right now to feel supported?
